title: kate-core: accept lf, crlf, and cr in a modeline
summary: A modeline eol value accepts lf, crlf, and cr. The values unix, dos, and mac stay valid. The test goes in the existing modeline tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: modeline.rs is a private module of document.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Change only modeline_ending. The body is one match. "unix" | "lf" returns Some(LineEnding::Lf). "dos" | "crlf" returns Some(LineEnding::CrLf). "mac" | "cr" returns Some(LineEnding::Cr). Any other word returns None. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not fold ASCII case. Do not touch ec_ending, set_modeline_rest, kate_bool, modeline_overrides, editorconfig_overrides, set_width, or indent_style. The test a_modeline_accepts_lf_crlf_and_cr uses modeline_overrides. kate: eol lf; sets line_ending to Some(LineEnding::Lf). kate: eol crlf; sets Some(LineEnding::CrLf). kate: eol cr; sets Some(LineEnding::Cr). kate: eol unix; stays Some(LineEnding::Lf). kate: eol dos; stays Some(LineEnding::CrLf). kate: eol mac; stays Some(LineEnding::Cr). kate: eol LF; stays None. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: document::modeline::tests::a_modeline_accepts_lf_crlf_and_cr
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. eol lf leaves the line ending unset. After the change lf is Lf, crlf is CrLf, and cr is Cr. unix, dos, and mac stay the same. LF stays unset.
